displayName: Number of passwords required before user can reuse a password
description: Use this setting to restrict users from creating previously used work profile passwords. Enter the number of previously used passwords that can't be used, from 1-24. For example, enter 5 so users can't set a new password to their current password or any of their previous four passwords. If the value is blank, Intune doesn't change or update this setting. Available for corporate-owned work profile devices (at work profile level).
